description: React component for managing package preferences, including listing extensions, installing external plugins via URL, and uninstalling extensions within a web application.

classes.name: PackagesPreferencesSection
classes.description: React functional component for managing package extensions, including listing, installing via URL, and uninstalling.

methods.name: loadExtensions
methods.description: Loads extensions of specific content types from the application.

methods.name: uninstallExtension
methods.description: Confirms and uninstalls a specified extension.

methods.name: submitExtensionUrl
methods.description: Downloads external feature from URL and sets it for confirmation.

methods.name: handleConfirmExtensionSubmit
methods.description: Handles user confirmation for installing external package.

methods.name: confirmExtension
methods.description: Inserts the confirmed extension into the application and refreshes the list.
